# graylog_index_template (Data Source)

Gets Graylog index template for a given index set ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graylog_index_template" "example" {
  index_set_id = "existing-index-set-id"
}

output "index_template_name" {
  value = data.graylog_index_template.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `index_set_id` (String) Index set ID.

### Read-Only

- `index_patterns` (List of String)
- `mappings_json` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `order` (Number)
- `settings_json` (String)
